name: Dark Illusions
source:
In this game the main character decides to get away from it all during his spring break and stay in the mountains. While staying in the mountains a massive storm causes the main character to faint. A mysterious woman saves him and uses sexual pleasure to keep him warm. It turns out that he is now in a strange old mansion. The woman who saved the main character is the mistress in charge of the place. The main character decides to explore and while there meets many women as the story unfolds...

Dark Illusions is a western remake of "[url=https://vndb.org/v725]Nocturnal Illusion[/url]" in RPG Maker for PS1. The game adds adventure game elements, like puzzles and obstacle courses, removes the presence of Kusayama and adds additional secret characters, one of them being Priss from developer's first game "Treasure Hunters".
translation:
这款游戏中，主人公决定在春假期间远离一切，前往山中度假。山里逗留时，一场巨大风暴让主人公昏倒。一名神秘女子救了他，用性快感为他保暖。后来他发现自己身处一座奇怪的古老宅邸。救他的女人是宅邸女主人。主人公决定探索宅邸，在故事展开过程中遇到许多女人……

《Dark Illusions》是《[url=https://vndb.org/v725]Nocturnal Illusion[/url]》的西式重制版，使用RPG Maker制作，登陆PS1。游戏加入谜题、障碍赛等冒险元素，移除了草山，并增加秘密角色，其中一人是开发者首作《Treasure Hunters》中的普莉丝。
